title: 第3章 拔舌地狱
slug: 花千骨全本免费-花千骨最新章节列表
content_zh:
成千上万条舌头密密麻麻的从高空中用红线垂挂下来，参差不齐，布满头顶，好像悬挂的尸体。而各种各样的舌头，有的大有的小，有的颜色深有的颜色浅，有的干枯发黑，像枯萎的花朵。而有的还舌苔鲜红，舌尖在微微颤动，仿佛不甘红线的捆绑在拼命挣扎，截断的那头甚至还滴着新鲜的血液，就像刚刚从人嘴里拔出来一样。
花千骨一阵作呕，只觉得浑身上下像有千百万只蚂蚁在爬。
连忙转身往回走，却嘭的撞在一个人身上，吓得又是一阵惊声尖叫。
三魂不见了七魄的睁大眼睛看着面前的也不知是人是鬼。一袭宽大的黑衣，犹如蝙蝠的翅膀，上面有奇怪的三角图案与暗纹。脸上戴着一个极端狰狞又恐惧的饿鬼面具，突爆的眼球，还有伸出来的上面扎满了钉子的长长的舌头。
“阿弥陀佛，不要吃我，阿弥陀佛，不要吃我……”花千骨连连鞠躬，以前听村里说书的老人就讲十八层地狱里有一层叫拔舌地狱，那里的小鬼专爱吃人的舌头。
佛言：喜两舌谗人、恶口、妄言、绮语、或贡高诽谤经道、嫉贤妒能、恃才傲物，入此地狱。
狱中鬼卒会用烧红的铁钩直接勾断人的舌头，或者用铁钳夹住舌头，硬生生拔下，而且不是一下拔下，而是慢慢拉长，拽细。然后再用烧红的铁刺刺穿人的咽喉，叫人求生不能，求死不得，不能言语，痛苦万分，至千万岁尽。一般再投胎为人者，也多患瘖哑不能言语。
呜呜呜，莫非自己掉进了拔舌地狱啦？
“我吃你做什么？”
却突然听到一个尖锐缓慢的说话，诡异得却根本就不像是人的声音，花千骨掉了满地的鸡皮疙瘩。
却见那恶鬼模样的家伙，低下头来，慢慢贴近花千骨的脖子，然后深吸了一口气，喉咙里发出咕噜咕噜的赞叹声，像是闻到了好吃的东西。
“我不好吃的！浑身又脏又臭，你别吃我！我连着赶路已经好些日子没洗澡了！！”
花千骨一面侧身，一面想溜，无奈路被那人堵住了。
“你居然破了阵闯进这里，被你看到了异朽阁最大的秘密，难道还想，就这样离开？”
花千骨欲哭无泪，吊那么多恶心的舌头，谁想看啊！退了两步，借着墙上微光，低下头去看对面人地上的影子，还好还好，不是鬼，不是鬼。
“我不是故意的啊，我保证不会说出去，我很健忘的，我一出去就把今天发生的所有事全部都忘了！你相信我！”
“哦？我相信你，可是我凭什么相信你呢？你要我相信你的代价是什么？”
“我，我，我发誓！若有违背，我不得好死！”
面前的人突然抽出一把刀子递到她面前。
“啊！不是吧，要杀人灭口！？”

“留下你的一滴血。”
“啊？什么？”
“留下你的一滴血。”
“只要一滴血啊，那好办好办。”花千骨咬紧牙关，狠下心去，终于在食指上割了一道口子，挤了一滴血出来。滴在了那人递过来的一个亮亮的东西上。
“这下我可以走了吧？”太可怕了，位于那么多舌头的虎视眈眈之下，面前还有那么恐怖的一个人。
“你不是来找我问问题的嘛，都还没问，就这么急着想离开？”
花千骨愕然：“你，你是异朽君？”
“是。”声音拖得长长的，显得阴阳怪气。花千骨再怎么想也没想到传说中的异朽君是这个样子，不过倒也没刚才那么害怕了。
“你喜欢吃萝卜？”突然很好奇的忍不住问道。
对面的人咳嗽两声，花千骨觉得他是在面具下失笑。
“这就是你要来向我请教的问题么？”
“啊，不是不是，有比这更要紧的。我是想问问你我想去茅山拜师学艺，可是怎么都上不了山，有什么办法没有？”
异朽君沉吟片刻。
“对哦，回答也是需要付出代价的。还要血么？我多得是！”花千骨一副大义凛然的卷起了袖子。
“这个问题太简单了，用不着付出你的血，你不知道你的血多精贵，不要随便浪费。你只需要告诉我你的生辰八字，还有姓名籍贯，总之越详细越好。”
花千骨疑惑的皱眉，是查户籍的么？告诉他那些应该无所谓吧？他不会用巫术给自己下降头吧？却也只有老老实实的说了出来。

content_en:
Thousands of tongues hang densely from high in the sky with red threads, unevenly covering the top of the head, like hanging corpses. There are various tongues, some big and some small, some dark and some light, some dry and black, like withered flowers. Some still have bright red tongue coating, and the tip of the tongue is trembling slightly, as if it is struggling desperately against the binding of the red thread, and the severed end is even dripping with fresh blood, as if it had just been pulled out of the mouth.
Hua Qiangu felt nauseated and felt like there were millions of ants crawling all over her body.
He quickly turned around and walked back, but bumped into someone, causing him to scream again in fright.
The three souls disappeared and the seven souls looked at the person in front of them with wide eyes, not knowing whether it was a human or a ghost. Wearing a large black suit, it looks like a bat's wings, with strange triangular patterns and dark lines on it. On his face was an extremely ferocious and frightening hungry ghost mask, with protruding eyeballs and a long tongue stuck out with nails on it.
"Amitabha, don't eat me, Amitabha, don't eat me..." Hua Qiangu bowed repeatedly. In the past, the old storyteller in the village said that one of the eighteen levels of hell is called the Tongue Pulling Hell, where the little devils love to eat people's tongues.
The Buddha said: Those who are fond of slandering others, using harsh words, lying, and gossiping, or slandering the scriptures, being jealous of talents, and being arrogant because of their talents will enter this hell.
Prison guards would use red-hot iron hooks to directly cut off people's tongues, or they would use iron pliers to clamp the tongues and pull them out forcibly. And instead of pulling them out all at once, they would slowly stretch and pull them thin. Then a red-hot iron thorn is used to pierce the person's throat, making the person unable to live, unable to die, unable to speak, and in excruciating pain until the end of thousands of years. Generally, those who are reincarnated as humans are often suffering from fistula and muteness and cannot speak.
Woohoo, could it be that I have fallen into the tongue-pulling hell?
"Why should I eat you?"
But suddenly she heard a sharp and slow voice, which was so weird that it didn't even resemble a human voice. Hua Qiangu had goosebumps all over the floor.
But he saw the evil-looking guy lowering his head, slowly getting close to Hua Qiangu's neck, and then took a deep breath, making a gurgling sound of praise in his throat, as if he smelled something delicious.
"I don't like food! I'm dirty and smelly, don't eat me! I haven't taken a shower for several days since I was on the road!!"
Hua Qiangu turned sideways and wanted to escape, but his way was blocked by that person.
"You actually broke through and broke into this place, and you saw the biggest secret of the Immortal Pavilion. Do you still want to leave like this?"
Hua Qiangu wants to cry but has no tears, hanging so many disgusting tongues, who wants to see it! I took two steps back, and with the dim light on the wall, I lowered my head to look at the shadow of the person on the ground opposite me. Fortunately, it was not a ghost, not a ghost.
"I didn't mean it. I promise I won't tell anyone. I'm very forgetful. As soon as I went out, I forgot everything that happened today! You believe me!"
"Oh? I believe you, but why should I believe you? What is the price you want me to pay for trusting you?"
"I, I, I swear! If I violate it, I will die!"
The person in front of her suddenly pulled out a knife and handed it to her.
"Ah! No, you want to kill people and silence them!?"
"Leave a drop of your blood."
"Huh? What?"
"Leave a drop of your blood."
"All it takes is a drop of blood. It's easy to handle." Hua Qiangu gritted her teeth, worked hard, and finally made a cut on her index finger and squeezed out a drop of blood. It dropped on a shiny object handed over by the man.
"Can I leave now?" It was too scary. Under the gaze of so many tongues, there was such a terrifying person in front of him.
"Didn't you come to me to ask questions? You haven't even asked me yet, and you're so anxious to leave?"
Hua Qiangu was astonished: "You, you are the Lord of Immortality?"
"Yes." The voice was drawn out and sounded strange. No matter how much she thought about it, Hua Qiangu never thought of the legendaryThis is how the King of Immortality looks like, but he is not as scared as before.
"Do you like to eat radishes?" I was suddenly curious and couldn't help but ask.
The person opposite coughed twice, and Hua Qiangu felt that he was laughing under his mask.
"Is this the question you came to ask me for?"
"Ah, no, no, there is something more important than this. I want to ask you. I want to go to Maoshan to study with a teacher, but I can't get up the mountain. Is there any way?"
Lord Yiwu pondered for a moment.
"Yes, there is a price to pay for the answer. Do you want more blood? I have more!" Hua Qiangu rolled up his sleeves with a righteous look.
"This question is too simple. There is no need to sacrifice your blood. You don't know how precious your blood is, so don't waste it. You only need to tell me your date of birth, name and place of origin. In short, the more detailed the better."
Hua Qiangu frowned in confusion, was he checking the household registration? It shouldn't matter if you tell him that, right? He wouldn't use witchcraft to lower his head, would he? But he could only say it honestly.
